text:
jamie: Quick deploy starting in ~10m for the dedicated EU pool. Can someone point me to the saved search that filters for region=eu, model=zenith, route=/generate and shows 5xx OR latency >200ms OR kv_cache_miss? Want to run a smoke check before the canary.

alex: There's a savedsearch we usually use. Try 'deploy-smoke/eu-zenith' in LogSearch — I just pinned the link: https://logs.redwood.com/savedsearches/5843

Query snippet you can copy:

```
org:acme model:zenith region:eu route:/generate (status:5xx OR latency_ms:>200 OR kv_cache_miss:true)
| sort @timestamp desc
```

marta: If you need to compare Dedicated vs Hosted, add `deployment:dedicated` or `deployment:hosted` to the query. Ping me if you get a permissions error.

jamie: thanks! Also — what's the recommended alert for kv cache spikes during canary? Want something simple to catch regressions.

sre-bot: [automated] Created ticket INC-2024-334 for alert request (assigned to eng-platform).

alex: For a quick signal, use a rolling 5m p95 kv_cache_miss rate > 1% for the acme tenant in EU. Example alert rule pseudocode:

```
metric: kv_cache_miss_rate{org="acme", region="eu"} 
aggregation: p95 over 5m
trigger: value > 0.01
notify: #eng-oncall, ops-sms
```

marta: I'll create the alert and attach the savedsearch. Saved alert name: `alert/smoke/eu-zenith`. Assigning to eng-platform oncall for the week of the deploy. Also created a more conservative monitoring view called `smoke/deploy/eu-zenith` (so there are two saved searches; use the one prefixed with `smoke/` for post-deploy checks).

jamie: awesome — can you also drop a dashboard link with p95, 5xx rate, and kv miss rate? :thumbsup:

marta: Done. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.com/d/xyz/smoke-deploys?panelId=7 — panels: p95 latency, 5xx count, kv_cache_miss rate. I also added a quick note in the dashboard header with the savedsearch id and alert id.

alex: FYI I'm adding a short blurb to the release notes about the smoke check and the new alert. Tagging this thread for the deploy checklist.

jamie: perfect, thanks all. Starting in 8m.
